That needs the full_position_stop branch to stop returning before it has looked, or a separate leg-count read; note it costs a get_open_orders call the branch currently avoids, so it is a real trade-off and not a free fix. Proven by an observed over-cover page on a mixed-mode bracket, never by a test. (2) THE RE-ARM: the adopt path's naked re-arm consults existing broker coverage before placing, or cancels the closing row's tracked legs. ⚠️ DO NOT RESOLVE (2) BY CANCELLING LEGS ON THE LIVE POSITION AS A ONE-OFF — BL-20260820-OVERCOVER-REMEDIATION-CANCELLED-THE-JOURNAL-MATCHING-LEG is what happened the last time that was attempted. The current 200% instance is expected to clear when the root cause lands and this position closes normally; if it clears that way, that is NOT evidence either half is fixed.
